Subject: Launch thermostat & OKR sync — QBR prep and action owners

Team — kicking off a short thread to consolidate readiness for next week’s QBR. High-level ask: please fill the attached QBR_ask_grid.xlsx and update the linked Drive folder by Tue 10/20 EOD so I can consolidate a one-pager for leadership.

Quick checklist by area (fill owner / status / blockers):
- GTM (demand gen, playbook, sales enablement slots)
- Enablement (playbook, recorded SME walkthroughs, certification plan)
- Pricing (pilot pricing, concession guardrails, approval path)
- Docs (API guide updates, quickstart rewrite, troubleshooting KB)
- Support (escalation path, SLA exceptions, on-call coverage for launch week)

Attachments: QBR_ask_grid.xlsx, launch_scope.md

Key risks I already see: incomplete enablement artifacts and an open pricing ask from Brightwell that needs quick alignment. If you need a short 15m sync with me before Tue, propose times.

Thanks —
Dylan Brooks
Sr. Manager, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Adding pricing context — I pushed an updated pricing_playbook_v2.docx to the Drive and flagged two pilot options for review:
1) Standard pilot: 90d, usage-based pricing, standard SLAs.
2) Accelerated pilot: 60d, 15% onboarding concession, committed capacity (minimum monthly), shortened support SLA during pilot window.

Brightwell (cc’d) indicated preference for the accelerated pilot but procurement asked for written guardrails. I recommend we surface both options in QBR and request leadership signoff on concession threshold (max 15% for enterprise pilots without exec approval).

Action: Dylan — can you confirm if leadership will accept a delegated 15% concession threshold or do we need exec approval on a per-deal basis?

Thanks everyone — consolidation below and next steps for the QBR one-pager I will circulate tomorrow morning. Please treat these as committed owners unless you update me in writing by EOD tomorrow.

Consolidated owners & near-term deliverables:
- GTM: Laura — finalize GTM_tactics_deck_v3.pdf; share top-3 metrics we’ll highlight in QBR (due 10/23).
- Enablement: Marissa — finish playbook + record SME walkthrough (due 10/23).
- Pricing: Markus — finalize pricing_playbook_v2.docx and draft pilot guardrails (due 10/21) — leadership decision requested: delegated 15% concession? (please confirm).
- Docs: Kimberly — thin API quickstart for Brightwell + KB stub (due 10/21).
- Support: (Kimberly / Ops) — escalation path doc (attach to grid) and on-call coverage plan for launch week (due 10/23).

Deliverables attached/linked: QBR_ask_grid.xlsx, GTM_tactics_deck_v3.pdf, enablement_checklist.pdf, pricing_playbook_v2.docx. Jira ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-1234 (tracking open tech blockers).

Jane / Brightwell — cc’ing you so you see the proposed pilot options. We will highlight both in the QBR and confirm final option with your procurement team after leadership review.

If no objections, I’ll prepare a one-page summary and OKR impact bullets for Wednesday’s leadership QBR.

Thanks —
Dylan Brooks
Sr. Manager, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
